name: tackle
description: tackle — small tools for agent sessions.

plugins.name: cull
plugins.description: Judge a project's automated tests with Jev and remove the ones that don't earn their place; Court reviews only what Jev is unsure about, on cull's review page. Bundles cull's tools and the mod that delivers Court's answers into this session.

plugins.name: imprint
plugins.description: Guides npm package work: logging in, publishing a tarball, setting or moving a package's trusted publisher, deprecating a package and confirming a CI release, one npm step at a time. Bundles imprint's tools and the mod that delivers each step's progress into this session.

plugins.name: sift
plugins.description: Audit the instruction files coding agents read and recommend a revised version of each; the user accepts, edits or rejects each file on sift's review page. Bundles sift's tools and the mod that delivers the user's decisions into this session.
